messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the FP8/INT8/4-bit RFC — who owns the precision contract between runtime and model infra?
aj: good question. by 'precision contract' you mean the public API + the runtime fallback behaviour, right?
maria: yep. specifics like: config schema, semantic guarantees (max quality drop), and who implements shim fallbacks.
kevin: my take: model infra should own profile generation and validation (calibration data, per-slice tolerances). runtime owns enforcement and fast fallbacks.
sophie: agree with kev but want to call out telemetry ownership. If model infra declares 'max_quality_loss: 2%' we need clear signals for measuring that in runtime + who alerts.
maria: sounds reasonable. proposal: three layers — profile authoring (model infra), runtime execution & enforcement (runtime), and observability & rollouts (platform).
aj: practical question: where does the profile schema live? single source-of-truth in model infra repo, with runtime vendored parser?
kevin: yes, schema in model infra. runtime includes a compatibility shim and validation lib. keep it small (json schema ~200 lines).
quant-bot: note: existing old-profiles v1 will be deprecated in 2 weeks per RFC timeline.
sophie: can we add a soft-fallback in runtime when encountering unknown fields? We should avoid hard failures during deploys.
aj: soft-fallback+warning sounds right. runtime logs warning and falls back to conservative profile (e.g., INT8 fallback to FP16 ops)
maria: good — documentable behavior: unknown profile field => runtime emits telemetry tag 'profile:unknown-field' and uses conservative path.
kevin: debating an interface: runtime exposes /validate-profile endpoint for CI. Model infra CI hits that to fail fast.
sophie: +1. also want a linting step in model infra that runs small sample in a canary runtime to estimate deg metrics.
aj: about rollout: where should canary gating live? platform (console) or model infra pipelines?
maria: platform for release gating (canary %, rollback), model infra for producing artfacts and baseline metrics. we need a handshake — model infra pushes profile artifact + baseline metrics; platform coordinates rollout and observes deviation.
kevin: long-term refactor idea: split 'precision profile' into two orthogonal pieces: 1) resource hints (preferred quant, kernels, perf targets), 2) quality constraints (per-slice max_loss, golden prompts). That way runtime can ignore quality constraints if it can't measure them.
sophie: that would simplify runtime surface. runtime only needs to understand perf hints and a small 'safety' field. Quality constraints stay with evaluator + platform.
aj: can we capture that split in schema now? quick example:
```
{
  "version":"v2",
  "resource_hints": {"preferred_quant":"fp8", "kernel":"fused-attn"},
  "quality_constraints": {"max_loss_pct": 1.5, "golden_set_id":"gs-923"}
}
```
kevin: perfect. runtime validates resource_hints and enforces or falls back. platform watches quality_constraints.
quant-bot: telemetry schema update: add fields 'profile_version', 'resource_hint_used', 'quality_violation'.
maria: next steps: 1) model infra to publish v2 schema draft + migration guide (owner: kevin, due EOD Tue) 2) runtime to implement soft-validate + conservative fallback + /validate-profile endpoint (owner: aj, due Thu) 3) platform to add rollout hook + telemetry keys (owner: sophie, due next Mon)
sophie: I'll prototype rollout UI tags for profile auditing.
aj: will post design doc for validate endpoint with simple examples.
kevin: will add conversion script from v1->v2 profiles and a small CI job.
maria: thanks. small ops question — does anyone object to runtime returning a non-200 on profiles that are structurally invalid? we still want deploys to fail for malformed JSON.
aj: no objection. malformed => 4xx, unknown-but-parseable => 200 with warning.
sophie: agreed.
kevin: one more: we should keep an escape hatch to force FP16 for customer-critical routes via route config (not profile). use-case: emergency quality rollback.
maria: yes, include 'route-level override' in docs.
quant-bot: action-log: owners registered (kevin, aj, sophie).
maria: awesome. I'll follow up with a slim RFC update and links to tasks. if anyone wants to pair on the schema feel free to ping me. :thumbsup:
